Package hu.bme.mit.theta.frontend.transformation.grammar.type

Class LayoutAttributes

java.lang.Object
hu.bme.mit.theta.frontend.transformation.grammar.type.LayoutAttributes
public final class LayoutAttributes extends Object
Reads the two GCC attributes that change an object's layout out of the attribute lists the grammar already parses: packed and aligned(n).

Every other attribute stays ignored, which is the long-standing behaviour -- they describe things this frontend does not model. These two are different only because ObjectLayout cannot compute correct offsets without them: a packed struct laid out unpacked puts every member after the first in the wrong place.

GCC spells both with and without underscores (packed, __packed__), and CIL emits either, so both are accepted.
